notes.title: Update 1.1.5
notes.notes:
Hey everyone we're back with a small but highly requested update.

- After getting one of the main endings(Saint, Demon, Soulless, Snake) you will notice something new at the front of each cavern that'll allow you to skip answering the questions. 
- We also fixed a couple bugs and typos that we found.

[b]Future[/b]

We're also working on more content for WIWI, but we're also working on our next game, Born Into Fear, so development will be a little slow.

notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.notes:
-Fixed platforms getting stuck.

notes.title: Was It Worth It? Is now live!
notes.notes:
Was It Worth it is now live and available for purchase. We're planning to add more content to the game in the coming weeks (free of charge). For now, we'll be keeping an eye out for any issues players might come across in the game. Otherwise, we hope you have a good experience with this weird game. 

Take care, until next time.
